ai_summary: Aban Offshore Limited, currently undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP), faces critical going-concern uncertainties and has received a complete disclaimer of conclusion from its auditors on the unaudited Q1 FY2027 standalone financial results. This extreme red flag is driven by the non-recognition of substantial finance costs (bank borrowings and preference dividends) and unresolved issues concerning the recoverability of overdue investments and inter-corporate loan interest, rendering the reported net profit of INR 330.25 million for the quarter highly unreliable and likely overstated. The company's accumulated losses and eroded net worth further underscore its precarious financial position.
